scope: Ride reliability: offline BLE/state tests, trainer load, Windows builds and native UI verification

hardwareValidation.note: No new physical ride or BLE hardware validation was performed for the gradient/load changes.

gurten.provenance: Public OpenStreetMap route geometry with swisstopo terrain elevation; reconstructed course rather than a recorded GPX.
gurten.sampling: Existing route points at nominal 5 m intervals; final interval may be shorter. P95 = sorted adjacent changes[floor(0.95 * count)].

trainerFilter.calculation: Elevation difference divided by summed rendered horizontal segment length; switchbacks are not shortcut by an endpoint chord.
trainerFilter.unchanged: Rendered elevation, displayed local grade, avatar physics, calibration signature and saved rise rate.
trainerFilter.tradeoff: Short terrain transitions are averaged across 20 m on either side; sustained grades are retained.

loadControl.increase: Saved calibrated rise rate, or existing default; capped to at most one second of progress per update.
loadControl.normalDecrease: At most twice the configured rise rate.
loadControl.calibration: Default TorqueRamp behavior remains immediate on reductions; no calibration schema or signature changes.

checks.name: BikeProfileTests.Verify
checks.coverage: Existing shared bike dynamics, profile validation, gearing and torque ramp regression.

checks.name: TrainerLoadTests.Verify
checks.coverage: 40 m grade continuity; synthetic 5 m noise; constant 20% climbs; switchback arc length; unchanged geometry; asymmetric calibrated load ramps; easier gears; low-cadence, zero-target, stop and restart release.

checks.name: TrainerLoadTests.VerifyGurten
checks.coverage: Real public Gurten climb: reduced adjacent grade jumps while retaining steep sections above 20%.

checks.name: Windows Release builds and full application self-tests
checks.coverage: Public: Uetliberg, Gurten, Eiger. Local: those courses plus preserved private Dentenberg assets. Calibration, physics, sectors, seeking, braking and records regressions.

checks.name: BluetoothReliabilityTests.Verify and PreferencesStore.Verify
checks.coverage: Independent Click slots/migration, manufacturer/service discovery, mirrored button filtering, malformed packets, invalidated subscriptions, pulse freshness and stale-state recovery policy; no radio fixtures.

checks.name: Node mouse input regressions and scene syntax
checks.coverage: Scene left/right shifts, demo, paused state, UI boundaries, modifiers, dragging, cancellation and cleanup.

checks.name: Native offline UI
checks.coverage: Four visible configuration cards and HUD chips; mouse shifts observed 8 to 9 to 10 and back to 9; paused scene click and profile seek retained gear 9; seek moved to 3.263 km; demo resumed with load inactive.

checks.name: Local installation
checks.coverage: Normal close of paused app; candidate executable/assets installed; 15 protected settings/records/private-course files unchanged by SHA-256. No private data included in this report.

testExecution: Production Windows Release executables ran --self-test for public and personal course sets. Node mouse regression tests and JavaScript syntax checks passed. Native CUA interactions used an isolated offline copy with auto-search disabled; no physical load tests were performed.
